failure_summary.description: Did not interpret “a first flight” as a first-class fare preference.
Used one outbound search with an arrival date instead of separate outbound and reverse-direction return searches.
Did not assign and cache the flight search result.

patch.reasoning: The skill already specifies separate directional searches for date spans and requires saving every result, so those instructions do not need repeating. The remaining semantic gap is recognizing “a first flight” as first class rather than an unspecified flight.

edits.content: - When a user asks for “a first flight” or a “first-class flight” as a fare preference, use `flight_class=["first"]` on every described leg. Distinguish this from “the first flight” or “the earliest flight,” which refers to departure timing.
